en.text: Human blood contains red cells, white cells and [[1]], which help it to clot. Red cells carry oxygen bound to the protein [[2]]. People with blood group [[3]] negative are called universal donors, and those with [[4]] positive are universal recipients. The human heart has [[5]] chambers.
en.why: Plasma is the liquid part of blood, not a cell. Myoglobin stores oxygen in muscle. A three-chambered heart is found in most amphibians and reptiles.
